subject: Data Engineering
title: Clustering and Sort Keys
description: A micro-lesson that makes Clustering and Sort Keys usable.

hook.text: A query filters by date, but the warehouse scans every file. Sorting the data by date fixes this.

buildup.text: Clustering physically organizes data by a key so the engine skips irrelevant file segments.

discovery.text: Sort keys in Redshift and cluster keys in Snowflake tell the warehouse how to arrange data on disk.

twist.text: Choosing a bad cluster key — or too many — can make writes slower without helping reads.

climax.text: Pick the column that appears most often in WHERE clauses. That's usually your best cluster key.

punchline.text: Sort your data the way you query it.

quiz.question: What does clustering data in a warehouse achieve?
options: Organizes data so queries skip irrelevant segments
